# Techstars Anywhere Accelerator

Techstars’ remote-first Anywhere program was launched in 2017 and supports companies innovating across any industry.

The Anywhere model delivers the value of a top-tier Techstars accelerator remotely, to companies in American timezones. Anywhere provides the flexibility to participate in an accelerator program without relocating, and meets for three in-person offsites in startup hubs during the program.

Click [**here**](https://airtable.com/appwN1iwXxVrfCpRQ/shryrWoFq1u7ireCi) to let us know you're interested in applying to the Techstars Anywhere Accelerator or ask us any question you have about the program. Plus, we'll keep you up-to-date on all the Techstars Anywhere events and announcements.

# **Techstars Accelerator Application Preview**

### **Overview**

##### **Learn More About Our Application Questions**

When you click the [apply](https://apply.techstars.com/) button to one of [Techstars accelerators](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators), you’ll be prompted to create a profile. When doing so, please ensure you create your profile using an email address you use and check often so we can send you critical application updates.

The Techstars mentorship-driven accelerator application consists of three main parts:

- Basic information about you (3-5 mins)

- Information about your company (20-30 minutes)

- Optional step to pick the top 3 accelerators you are interested in (3-5 minutes)


Each application can be submitted to specific accelerator programs, or you can submit a general application, and our teams will work to connect you to the right accelerators.

Submitting multiple applications does not increase your chances of acceptance, so take the time upfront to consider which of our accelerators is the best fit for you and your company.

**As you prepare your application, make sure to check out** [Tips from our Managing Directors](https://www.techstars.com/the-line/pov/applying-to-techstars-tips-from-our-managing-directors) **.**

Looking for more info on our application process?

- Learn more about our application process and programs currently accepting applications [here](https://www.techstars.com/apply/).

- Visit our [frequently asked questions](http://techstars.com/faq).


### **Application Questions**

Our goal is to better understand your team, market, progress, and idea with the following questions. We know you are busy running a company, but make sure you pay attention to the character limits and focus on answering the question.

##### **Founder Profile: Basic Information About You**

1. First name

2. Last name

3. Title

4. Contact email

5. Current location

6. Linkedin URL

7. Phone number

8. Working on your startup full time?


##### **Accelerator Application: Company Information**

01. Startup Name

02. Startup URL

03. What year was your company founded?

04. What problem is your company looking to solve?

05. What is your company going to make to solve this problem?

06. Startup incorporation information (if applicable)

07. What industries are relevant to your company?

08. Product demo video, pitch deck, and team introduction video

09. What makes your team a winning team?

10. Share any traction you have

11. Share any revenue and funding you have

12. How do you (or will you) make money? How much could you make?

13. Who is your target audience?

14. Who are your competitors or could become your competitors?

15. What is your competitive advantage?

16. Why is now the right time for your startup?

17. What is your customer acquisition strategy?

18. What are your next major company milestones?


##### **Program Selection**

Program choice: you can choose several accelerators that are accepting applications at any given time. This is an optional step; if you do not submit a preference, our teams will read your application and connect you with the accelerator most appropriate for your company.

### Techstars Launches Applications for its Spring 2025 Term of Accelerator Programs

###### Aug 26, 2024

Today Techstars launched [applications for the spring 2025 term](https://login.techstars.com/auth/realms/techstars/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=apply&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fapply.techstars.com%2F&state=179704cd-ed17-4718-86bc-bf2771ad970d&response_mode=fragment&response_type=code&scope=openid&nonce=6726b776-b008-4a9e-b93f-a913c6713fd7), which will kick off in March 2025. We’re excited to meet the next wave of early-stage founders looking to join the Techstars universe.

Founders who want to apply to the spring term will have the option to choose from 11 accelerator programs in 10 different cities across three countries, plus one fully remote program. All of our accelerator programs are deeply involved in their local startup ecosystems, while some focus on specific industries for those looking for an edge in their respective field:

- [Techstars Anywhere](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/anywhere)

- [Techstars London](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/london)

- [Techstars New York City](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/nyc)

- [Techstars San Francisco](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/san-francisco)

- [Techstars Web3](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/web3)

- [Build in Tulsa Techstars Accelerator](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/tulsa)

- [Techstars Workforce Development](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/workforce-development)

- [Techstars Columbus powered by OSU](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/ohio-state-university-accelerator)

- [USC and Techstars Digital Economy Program](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/usc-and-techstars-digital-economy-program)

- [Techstars AI Health Baltimore powered by Johns Hopkins University and CareFirst Blue Cross Blue Shield](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/baltimore-ai-health)

- [Northwestern Medicine & Techstars Healthcare Accelerator](https://www.techstars.com/accelerators/northwestern-medicine-healthcare)


If you’re not sure how to decide which to apply to, check out this blog post explaining [how to choose the right accelerator](https://www.techstars.com/blog/advice/inside-a-techstars-accelerator-how-to-choose-the-right-accelerator-for-your-company) for your team and your company.

**Why join Techstars?** Since 2006, we’ve supported the success of over 4,400 companies by providing funding, dedicated mentorship, hands-on training, and unparalleled access to Techstars' global network of VC investors, corporate partners, and alumni founders. While our accelerator programs take place over the course of 13 weeks, our founders experience the network effects of Techstars’ community for life (something we call #TechstarsForLife).

Those interested in applying can learn more [here](https://accelerate.techstars.com/founders?utm_source=hootsuite&utm_medium=&utm_term=&utm_content=&utm_campaign=). We encourage anyone looking to apply to check out this blog post for tips on [how to submit a standout application](https://www.techstars.com/blog/advice/how-to-successfully-apply-to-techstars-unraveling-the-application-process) for our programs.

# **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How much does Techstars invest and at what terms?**

A: Techstars' investment is **$220,000**, and the capital comes with all the benefits of our 3-month mentorship-driven accelerator program to get you to PMF, $2M+ perks from our partners, access to our world-class network of investors, partners, mentors, and alumni, and lifetime support on your startup.

The $220,000 offer comprises two components, including $200,000 through an **uncapped** MFN SAFE and $20,000 through a Post-Money Convertible Common Equity Agreement (CEA). The total equity Techstars receives will be 5% of the company in **common stock** plus the future value of the $200,000 uncapped MFN Safe. For example, if your next round is valued at $20M pre-money, the $200,000 MFN Safe would then convert into 1% additional ownership at that time.

**Q: What do you look for in founders for your programs in New York City?**

A: We look for founders who deeply understand their customers' pain, demonstrate the ability to execute quickly, and are building in a market large enough to make $1B+ in annual revenue a possibility. Founders can be based anywhere in the world but they can leverage the NYC's density and diversity of industry and capital to accelerate product-market fit.

**Q: I am working/studying right now; can I still participate in Techstars?**
A: You don't have to be full-time to apply to Techstars. However, if accepted into the program, we expect you'll dedicate full exclusivity to your startup with no other academic or work engagements.

**Q: I'm very busy running my company and don't have time for an accelerator. How much time does Techstars take?**

A: The Techstars NYC program is **not school;** we custom-tailor the program to your most immediate obstacles so that you can crush obstacles along the way and get to Product-Market Fit faster. Any time you spend with your mentors and program staff will be to help you do two years' worth of work in three months.

**Q: I have already closed or will soon close a round of funding. Am I too late-stage for Techstars?**

A: Many of our founders secure between $1M and $5M in funding before the program begins. Our Uncapped MFN SAFE ensures that Techstars aligns with any past or present investments, allowing us to boost your company’s success regardless of your starting stage in the program.

**Q: What is the format of the program in NYC?**

A: We front-load content and mentor matching during the first two weeks of in-person sessions, then personalize support for each company for whatever they need to accelerate PMF.

We achieve this level of personalization with an unparalleled ratio of 4 team members to startups during program. Founders only attend workshops that are beneficial to them and our mentor selection is done _after_ the class is finalized to bring in the most relevant advisors for each company.

The program format is hybrid, with in-person sessions for the first two weeks, one in-person week in the middle, and a demo day at the end. We will also work with you virtually as soon as offer is accepted before program starts and after program for whatever you need.

# How to Join the Techstars Accelerator: A Step-by-Step Guide

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67db4bde8f92402fd46a91c3/67db4bde8f92402fd46ac7fd_676186759c9f1e580a135026_6761864bba389c3aad54c0cc_ImageToStl.com_feacfaba-9622-4f96-a929-9d050c3fefdf.avif)

Here's a surprising fact - only 1% of startups make it into the Techstars accelerator. The ones that do get accepted raise an average of $2M in follow-on funding.

Many founders struggle with their applications. They miss significant requirements or don't showcase their startups well enough. Getting into Techstars takes more than just a brilliant idea. You need to understand the program deeply and know what makes the selection committee tick.

Techstars gives early-stage startups amazing opportunities. These include $120K in seed funding and access to a network of over 10,000 mentors. The challenge lies in making your application stand out among thousands of competitors.

Want to improve your chances of joining one of the world's most prestigious startup accelerators? Let's explore everything about getting into Techstars - from picking the right program to nailing your final interview.

## Understanding Techstars Program Types

Here's a look at the different types of Techstars programs founders can access. Techstars currently runs 45-50 accelerators worldwide each year. These programs give startups multiple opportunities through different formats and locations.

### City-Specific vs Corporate Programs

Two main types of accelerator programs shape our approach. City programs stay closely connected to local startup communities. Our corporate partnership programs bring specialized industry knowledge. To name just one example, we work together with major corporations like Cox Enterprises and venture firms like Pivotal Ventures. These partnerships help startups learn from industry experts and build valuable connections.

### Remote vs In-Person Options

Techstars Anywhere, our flagship remote program, has served founders since 2017. Traditional programs required relocation, but we now provide flexible options:

- **In-person programs**: Full immersion in cities like Boston, London, and Tel Aviv
- **Hybrid programs**: Mix of virtual and physical meetings
- **Remote-first**: Programs like Techstars Anywhere meet in person only three times throughout the program

### Program Calendar and Deadlines

A monthly accelerator term schedule started in January 2023. This structure enables over 600 early-stage entrepreneurs to join our programs throughout the year. Each program lasts three months. Application windows and start dates vary by location.

The program timeline follows these steps:

1. Applications open (usually 3-4 months before start)
2. Final application deadline
3. Program start date
4. [Demo Day presentation](https://pitchbob.io/blog/pitching-tips-from-2-demo-days-space-tech-accelerator)

The upcoming Techstars Anywhere cohort opens applications on August 26th, 2024, with a final deadline of November 23rd, 2024. The program begins March 10th, 2025, and concludes with Demo Day on June 5th, 2025.

## Meeting Basic Requirements

Techstars reviews potential companies through several key criteria, and [team quality](https://pitchbob.io/pitch-deck-outline/team-slide) stands as our number one priority. We seek exceptional founders who can show why they're the right people to tackle their chosen problem.

### Team and Company Stage Criteria

Our team assessment focuses on these core qualities:

- Knowing how to learn and adapt
- Excellence in teamwork
- Defined roles with complementary expertise
- History of getting things done

Here's something unexpected: we don't set strict stage requirements. Companies with zero revenue have accelerated right next to those making millions. Your team's potential and grasp of the market matter most.

### Industry Focus and Target Markets

We welcome founders from tech sectors of all types, including climatetech, artificial intelligence, mobility, quantum information science, advanced manufacturing, biotechnology, and 5G/IoT. Your market strategy should demonstrate:

Solid [market timing and growth potential](https://pitchbob.io/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-crafting-a-compelling-pitch-deck-for-winning-over-investors). Clear signals should show your target market's readiness for your solution. You need proof that people want what you're building - through prototypes, survey responses, or corporate interest.

### Geographic Considerations

Programs run worldwide and international founders can apply. These factors matter when picking a location:

- Industry networking opportunities
- Strength of local funding ecosystem
- Long-term company growth prospects

It's worth mentioning that your first choice location gets priority in reading your application, yet more than 30 Managing Directors review applications throughout our global network.

## Preparing Your Application

A strong application for our Techstars accelerator needs careful attention to detail and proper documentation. First-time applicants typically spend one to four hours to complete the process. This gives us a detailed view of your venture.

### Required Documentation

The application has three main components:

- Simple information about you (3-5 minutes)
- Detailed company information (20-30 minutes)
- Program priorities (3-5 minutes)

Note that you can update sections with new information as your company develops. We suggest getting feedback from mentors or advisors before submission.

### Video Pitch Guidelines

Your [video submissions](https://pitchbob.io/product-updates/pitchbob-io-launches-new-feature-to-simplify-elevator-pitch-creation) are vital components of the application. Keep your videos under one minute. Think of them as TV commercials that need to grab attention quickly. Your product demo video should focus on core functionality instead of login processes or peripheral features. Use the team video to showcase your group dynamics and passion to solve the problem.

### Financial Projections

Clear and realistic projections matter in financials. Your original pitch deck doesn't need detailed spreadsheets, but you should prepare:

- Five-year annualized revenue projections
- Current traction metrics and growth rates
- Clear revenue model explanation
- [Market size analysis](https://pitchbob.io/pitch-deck-outline/market-slide) (TAM, SAM, SOM)

We appreciate honest projections - you don't need to know everything. Your understanding of key business metrics and thoughtful approach to financial planning matter most.

## Navigating the Selection Process

Techstars maintains a competitive and thorough selection process. We review **thousands of applications** each year to find exceptional founders who can build influential businesses.

### Original Screening Round

Our managing directors personally review every application in the first round. Applications undergo review based on team strength, market potential, and knowing how to execute. Selected founders advance to interviews where they have a **one-in-two chance** to secure a spot in our accelerator.

### Interview Best Practices

The interview process has these stages:

- First round: Two 15-minute back-to-back interviews
- Second round: 30-40 minute in-depth discussion
- Final round: Panel interview with committee advisors

Your interview preparation should highlight:

- Mission-driven approach and dedication
- Working effectively with mentors
- Clear understanding of market opportunities
- [Team dynamics and execution capabilities](https://pitchbob.io/blog/top-15-common-pitch-deck-mistakes-and-how-to-avoid-them-to-have-an-efficient-deck)

### Final Selection Criteria

Six key factors determine our final decisions, ranked by importance:

1. Team (listed thrice because it's that significant)
2. Market potential
3. Traction
4. Core idea

Note that we seek more than great ideas - we want to see **strong entrepreneurs** who overcome obstacles and build successful businesses. You should openly discuss your weaknesses and show how you'll use our network to address them.

The final selection committee reviews your current status and growth potential. We strongly encourage you to reapply if you don't succeed at first. Many successful Techstars companies joined the program after multiple attempts.

## Conclusion

Success at Techstars demands careful preparation, yet the benefits outweigh the work. Our accelerator goes beyond the $120K seed funding. We give you access to world-class mentorship, valuable networks, and proven frameworks for [startup success](https://pitchbob.io/blog/maximizing-startup-success-with-201-seed-series-a-us-vcs-a-comprehensive-guide-for-emerging-enterprises---download).

Your team's quality drives our selection process. We welcome companies at different stages from a variety of industries. Exceptional founders with adaptability, market understanding, and execution capabilities grab our attention quickly. A well-crafted application, compelling video pitches, and strong interviews will help you stand out among thousands of applicants.

Many of Techstars' successful companies didn't succeed in their first attempt. Keep working on your pitch and deepen your team's commitment while building traction. Show us your authentic passion to solve ground problems and your drive to maximize our accelerator program's potential. Your startup could become Techstars' next success story.

Techstars accelerators have one goal: to help founders succeed.

Over the course of three months, we surround each startup with:

- A [$220K investment](https://www.techstars.com/newsroom/investment-terms)

It’s a proven model that’s helped build thousands of successful companies across the globe.
